features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a pneumatic lifting system that uses compressed air, not an integrated battery for power.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: A pneumatic lifting system 100 comprises a suction cup vacuum conduit 102 for connection to a suction cup 142
features.note: The quote mentions a 'suction cup 142', which inherently includes a flexible sealing lip to create a vacuum seal.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a suction cup but does not describe a flexible sealing lip or how it bounds a sealed region against a workpiece.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: A venturi valve 106 is fluidically couplable to a compressed air supply and the first section 102a and is configured to reduce the air pressure within the suction cup vacuum conduit 102
features.note: The reference discloses a venturi valve to reduce air pressure, which functions as a vacuum generator, but it is pneumatic, not an electric vacuum pump.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: A control valve 110 changes a position of the supply valve 108 to stop the supply of compressed air to the venturi valve 106 when the air pressure within the second section 102b of the suction cup vacuum conduit 102
features.note: The system monitors air pressure to control the supply valve, implying the presence of a pressure sensor.
features.refuted: The quote describes a control valve changing the position of a supply valve based on air pressure, but it does not mention a pressure sensor monitoring the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: Indicating means 210 may be operated when air pressure within the second section 102b of the suction cup vacuum conduit 102 falls below a threshold.
features.note: The reference describes an indicating means that operates when pressure falls below a threshold, which can serve as a warning.
features.refuted: The quote states that indicating means operate when air pressure falls below a threshold, but it does not specify that this threshold is above a release vacuum level, nor does it explicitly mention a 'warning indicator'.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference mentions a 'predetermined threshold pressure' for control and an 'indicating means' threshold, but does not specify how these thresholds are defined relative to a load-release vacuum.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference states the indicating means 'may be operated' when pressure falls below a threshold, but does not specify if it remains active.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The system uses a compressed air supply and pneumatic components, not a rechargeable battery.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference mentions 'Indicating means 210' but does not specify its physical location or visibility during operation.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: A pneumatic lifting system 100 comprises a suction cup vacuum conduit 102 for connection to a suction cup 142
features.note: The system is a 'pneumatic lifting system' and mentions a 'compressed air supply', implying external connections, thus not a single-hand portable design without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a pneumatic lifting system with suction cups, vacuum generation, pressure monitoring, and warning indicators, sharing some functional similarities with the subject invention, but it is pneumatically powered rather than battery-powered and lacks details on portability and spec
